## Overview
### Introduction to OpenAI o3
The OpenAI o3 model, released on 2025-04-16, is a premium, non-open-source language model provided by OpenAI. This model boasts an impressive set of capabilities, including text and vision processing, function calling, structured outputs, streaming, batch processing, and extended thinking. With a context window of 200,000 tokens and a maximum output of 100,000 tokens, o3 is well-suited for complex tasks that require in-depth analysis and reasoning.

### Technical Strengths and Use-Cases
OpenAI o3 demonstrates exceptional performance across various benchmarks, achieving scores of 94.2 on MMLU, 96.7 on HumanEval, 1390 on LMSYS Arena ELO, and 99.7 on GSM8K. These strengths make o3 an ideal choice for applications that involve complex reasoning, math, science, coding, research, and PhD-level problems. Additionally, o3 is suitable for tasks such as legal analysis and financial modeling, where its advanced capabilities can provide valuable insights. However, it is not recommended for simple tasks, high-volume applications, or use cases that require low latency or are budget-conscious.

* The application can tolerate some latency in processing.

#### Batch API Savings
